highlights.title: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
highlights.summary: Adobe is committing itself to the notion that chatbots and AI agents could be your next design assistant, or even automate creative workflows and repetitive tasks on your behalf.
body: Third-party AI agents can use Creative Cloud apps for you, and Firefly’s AI Assistant can run your social media accounts.

Local Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for Creative Cloud tools were previewed at the event, which aim to give you a choice between using Adobe’s own AI assistants, or the third-party agents you already use everyday. The integrations enable external AI agents from providers like OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic to work locally in Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and After Effects, where they can make direct changes to native project files on your computer.

You can take over from the agents at any time to manually refine the work because all layers, vectors, bins, and sequences remain editable. Agents that are connected to other MCP-capable tools can also include them in the same workflow, such as asking the AI agent to pull reference documents from Google Docs, design a project around them in Adobe’s tools, and then share the results with colleagues or clients in Slack. Creative Cloud local MCP integrations aren’t available yet, but Adobe says a private beta will be launching in early 2027.

highlights.title: How to get the Scarecrow Song in Ocarina of Time
highlights.summary: In The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, the Scarecrow Song is an optional but useful song you can unlock to help you get to otherwise impossible to reach places. You don't need the song to beat the game, but you will need it to get every Piece of Heart and Skulltula Token.
body: The song allows you to summon a scarecrow to a set location, allowing you to use your Hookshot to jump over to it. Nifty!
Below, we explain how to unlock the Scarecrow Song in the Ocarina of Time remake.

As young Link, talk to the scarecrows at Lake Hylia. They're right at the entrance on the farmed land. Pierre, the one closer to the entrance of the lake, will tell you to come up with a song yourself using your ocarina. Note that whatever you play here will become the Scarecrow Song. Feel free to be creative, but keep in mind that every time you play the Scarecrow Song, you'll have to watch Link play it out as you play it here. This means if you drag the song out to be very long, you'll get a long cutscene each time.

Memorize whatever you play here, take a screenshot of it, or write it down, as the game will not record it anywhere for you (yet). Talk to Bonooru, the second scarecrow, and play the song for him. He'll love it!

highlights.title: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things
highlights.summary: Adobe is expanding its Creative Cloud apps and Firefly AI platform with new capabilities that aim to make design and editing projects faster and less complicated. Some of the announcements from Adobe's Max event today include features for automatically removing objects, blemishes, and other…
body: Here are the new editing and design tools coming to Creative Cloud apps and Adobe’s Firefly suite.

In Premiere, Adobe is introducing a new Generative Remove tool in beta that lets you erase unwanted objects and distractions like boom mics and background clutter directly on the video editing timeline. Users can mask and track an object, click Remove, and then Premiere “fills the area with realistic detail” using generative AI, according to Adobe, while the rest of the footage surrounding the erased area remains untouched. We saw a similar capability called Project Frame Forward demonstrated in last year’s Sneaks showcase, which is what Adobe calls the experimental features it’s developing.

Premiere is also getting new sound editing tools that help to quickly clean up messy recordings and separate various audio sources — including dialogue, music, ambience, and sound effects — into individual tracks and elements. The Generative Media tool Adobe introduced earlier this year is now generally available, alongside the new Color Mode color editing experience that Adobe launched in beta in April.

highlights.title: BoJack Horseman: A Top Animated Season in TV History
highlights.summary: Occasionally, a TV show will come out that sticks with viewers even after they have finished watching it. Some seasons are even powerful enough to "enter the cultural zeitgeist as some of the best seasons.
body: Those are, of course, all live-action television shows that have achieved that status. It's rare for an animated series to be able to join those shows, but one Netflix series managed to do that.

BoJack Horseman follows BoJack Horseman (Will Arnett), a washed-up former television star living in Los Angeles. He's a man clothed in misery and contempt, and each season sees him burrowing further into his self-destructive behavior while pushing away everybody around him, from roommate Todd Chavez (Aaron Paul) to Princess Carolyn (Amy Sedaris).

By season four, BoJack Horseman had hit its stride. The characters were all developed and central enough to begin exploring more about their pasts, and after a devastating season three finale, it was clear that they still had a lot more to offer. As season four began, and BoJack escapes California, it is far from the new beginning or the true escape that he hoped for.

highlights.title: I have noticed a pattern with product ratings that could lead to biased reviews. Is it legal?
highlights.summary: The practice you’ve noticed is colloquially known as ‘review gating’, writes consumer affairs and policy professional Kat George. And no, it isn’t legal. I have noticed that when I get an email inviting me to review a product or service I have purchased online or physically, if I select a high…
body: Kat says: Screening reviews and sorting feedback based on a consumer’s initial sentiment is known colloquially online as “review gating”. It’s a dark pattern that is common enough that Google has banned it outright. And while the Australian consumer law doesn’t name the practice explicitly, it is clearly prohibited under laws relating to business reviews and false and misleading practices.

In early 2026, Google made some pointed changes to its Maps User Generated Content policy. The new policy states that Google does not allow businesses to “discourage or prohibit negative reviews, or selectively solicit positive reviews from customers”. What you have described sounds like businesses doing both of those things.

Google also has real consequences for businesses that are found to be in breach of its policy, so your experience is worth reporting directly to Google. Penalties include removing reviews that breach the policy, placing restrictions and alerts on business profiles, limiting the business’s eligibility to receive new reviews and temporarily hiding historical reviews.

highlights.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
highlights.summary: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
body: Kirt McMaster knows that his new operating system—Kora—won’t be for everyone, and he’s fine with that.

Kora, announced on Tuesday, is designed as a desktop alternative to Windows or macOS for “the AI native, not mass market,” he says. McMaster, the company’s CEO and cofounder—who also cofounded Boost Mobile—likens his strategy to how Steve Jobs targeted creators when overhauling desktop publishing with the Mac.

This “next-generation” desktop OS can integrate context from user interactions across multiple AI tools. Targeted to creators and developers, Kora’s central idea is to bring AI models together at the system level and help power users interact more seamlessly with multiple providers, rather than siloing everything off into desktop apps and browser tabs. It’s scheduled to launch sometime in 2027.

highlights.title: Nintendo Is Officially Investing in Game Preservation
highlights.summary: Game preservation has always been one of the biggest problems facing the industry. According to the Video Game History Foundation, 87% of classic video games released in the United States are critically endangered or lost.
body: A new job posting from Nintendo of America indicates that the company is now looking for a digital archivist. The person hired for the role will "design and implement a structured framework for organizing technical records, engineering documentation, source materials, and institutional knowledge related to legacy systems and platforms." Nintendo says the archivist will help ensure the company's historical records are "preserved for future generations." The position will be on a 12-month contract.

In the past, Nintendo has drawn criticism from the preservation community. In 2022, the Video Game History Foundation publicly criticized the company for announcing it would be closing the Wii U and 3DS eShops. The foundation released a statement saying that Nintendo's decision was "actively destructive to video game history." The statement also pointed out that Nintendo is part of the Entertainment Software Association, which funds lobbying that prevents a number of preservation efforts.

highlights.title: A Trump proposal would punish single parents. Other wealthy countries have a different approach
highlights.summary: Canada, the Netherlands and Sweden offer extra support to solo-parent households. In its latest pronatalist push, the Trump administration aims to shift funds away from them.
body: When news broke that the Trump administration planned to pay married couples to have one parent stay home with their kids, everyone from policy wonks to Redditors bemoaned what they saw as a new front in the mommy wars.

The proposal would shift funds that subsidize childcare for low-income working parents – the majority of them single parents who rely on childcare providers – to low-income married couples with one earner. Given that most single parents and stay-at-home parents are women, and both groups would be applying for the same limited funds, it seemed almost designed to pit moms against each other.

Details on the policy, initially reported by the New York Times, are scant. However, like many of other nominally pronatalist policy proposals the administration has entertained so far, it appears this one is less focused on addressing the deeper challenges that face parents and aspiring parents as celebrating a throwback family structure.

Designed to patrol inside your home when you’re not there, the Drone Cam is an AI-powered drone that can react to triggers from Ring sensors, such as detecting motion, a door opening, a water leak, or an alarm sounding. When triggered, it flies along preprogrammed routes to a set location, where it can livestream and record what’s happening in the Ring app.

highlights.summary: A scandal tests Nvidia’s dominance as tech billionaires seek to mend ties with Democrats after the midterm elections. This was originally published in TechScape, a newsletter about how technology shapes our lives. Sign up to receive it here.
body: Today in tech, we’re talking about Nvidia ’s salacious scandal, tech tycoons trying to reconcile with Democrats, and what billionaires should spend their money on if not elections.

On the opening night of Web Summit in Lisbon, the Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang’s admission that he had an affair with a Chinese datacenter executive suspected to be a spy for Beijing hit the main stage. The news broke less than 24 hours prior, and the reaction was surprising.
Matthew Prince, CEO of Cloudflare, broadened the implications of the scandal from Huang’s personal life to Nvidia’s market dominance.

“Whatever Jensen did in his personal life, that’s very salacious. In the longer term, whether Nvidia is the hero or the villain, we’ll be asking: Were the things they did to cement their market position … just financial engineering?” Prince said in front of tens of thousands of onlookers.

highlights.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
highlights.summary: Google DeepMind has revealed a new generation of the AI-powered Gemini Robotics platform. In the 2.5 release, Google says its robotic AI is getting tantalizingly close to completing real-world tasks as well as humans do.
body: DeepMind's physical AI platform has several computational layers between user input and robotic action. There's the vision-language model piece, which is Gemini Embodied Reasoning. Essentially, it takes your instructions and uses live video to plan how the robot can accomplish the task. The other main component is the vision-language-action (VLA) that actually generates robot actions, like moving an actuator—that's Gemini Robotics, which has been bumped to version 2.5.

DeepMind says that Gemini Robotics 2.5 is much better at tasks that require a high degree of dexterity. The model was evaluated across more than 200 activities, including serving food with tongs and using a pipette, as you would see in a laboratory. Google also showed that Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid robot with Gemini Robotics 2.5 can now tie a bow with its five-fingered hands, a notable feat, because deformable objects (like ribbon) are notoriously difficult for robots to manipulate.

highlights.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
highlights.summary: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.
body: Today, we’re sharing a milestone in software security long considered to be a grand challenge: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol, the technology that protects billions of private conversations in apps like Signal and Google Messages.

This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth that combines human expertise with AI agents. Formal verification—mathematically proving code runs correctly without flaws—is the highest standard of security assurance; however, it is difficult and often labor-intensive.

Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. It's also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI.

AlphaProof Code is a multi-LLM agentic framework that splits the work of formal verification the way a research team would: human experts work with AI to decide what to prove, and a group of AI agents does it.

highlights.summary: Age-gap relationship generated intense scrutiny. Hudson says clip invaded her privacy. Jordon Hudson is suing two Airbnb hosts over a Ring doorbell camera video of a bare-chested Bill Belichick.
body: Hudson, who went on to become a public presence by Belichick’s side, says in the lawsuit that the pair were keeping their romantic relationship private when they stayed at the Boston-area rental in the summer of 2023. However, the doorbell video – which showed a shirtless Belichick stepping out of the home – emerged that fall and soon made the rounds in the media.

Hudson wasn’t in the video, but she was later identified as the partner of the Super Bowl-winning head coach, who is almost 50 years her senior. Her lawsuit accuses the Airbnb hosts, Elise McDevitt and Craig Nolan, of leaking the footage and personal information about Hudson.

“These egregious violations of Ms Hudson’s privacy have, among other things, resulted in significant unwanted publicity and scrutiny of Ms Hudson and her relationship with Mr Belichick” and subjected her to ridicule, attorney Howard Cooper and colleagues wrote in a complaint filed on Friday in Massachusetts.
McDevitt, Nolan and Belichick have yet to respond publicly to the lawsuit.

highlights.title: You Don't Need a Current-Gen Console if You're Happy to Play GTA 6 at Xbox Series S Settings
highlights.summary: After months of speculation, Rockstar finally revealed that GTA 6 would be targeting 30 fps on all of the current-generation consoles, including the Xbox Series S. But, thanks to a cloud streaming deal with Xbox, you can technically play the game on the Xbox One.
body: While GTA 6 will only be running locally on the PS5 and Xbox Series consoles, Rockstar finally detailed which devices will be able to use Xbox Cloud Gaming to play the game. Its blog post says, "The game will also be available via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles, utilizing Xbox Series S graphics settings." So, you can technically play GTA 6 on the Xbox One, which launched all the way back in 2013, it just won't be, well, running on the Xbox One itself.

We've known for a while that GTA 6 would be playable via Xbox Cloud Gaming, after an exclusive deal was announced in October. At the time, because of the wide swath of devices that can use Xbox Cloud Gaming, this deal fueled speculation that you'd be able to play GTA 6 on everything from a gaming PC to an iPhone. However, Xbox Chief Strategy Officer Matthew Ball later clarified that the game wouldn't be streaming to PC. But, now, thanks to Rockstar's blog, we now know the full extent of devices that can stream GTA 6.

highlights.title: This Christmas, Harrods Is Doing Things Differently
highlights.summary: From a celestial façade and choreographed light shows to Dior experiences and bespoke gifting, Harrods is turning its Knightsbridge store into a festive destination.
body: There are few signs that Christmas has arrived in London quite like the Harrods store lighting up for the festive season. Every year, thousands of visitors descend upon Knightsbridge to see the store’s holiday transformation, and this year, the heritage retailer is giving them even more reason to stick around — and return again and again.

Unveiled on Tuesday, Harrods’s iconic terracotta façade has been revamped once again into a celestial spectacle, complete with 600 handcrafted stars, four kilometers of gold leaf, and more than 17,000 lights. The difference this year, however, is that the holiday campaign, Where the Stars Align, is the first wholly Harrods-created festive concept in several years. This follows a spree of collaborations with luxury houses, including Dior in 2022 and Loro Piana in 2024, which placed the retailer as secondary in its own Christmas storytelling.

This time, Harrods has brought multiple brands under its complete creative direction: each of its 24 Christmas windows feature unique installations from houses including Ralph Lauren, Van Cleef & Arpels, Chopard, Dior, Graff, Cartier, and Chanel Beauty.

highlights.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
highlights.summary: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.
body: In collaboration with Caregiver Action Network, Alzheimer’s Association, and American Diabetes Association ®, bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to five U.S. cities during National Family Caregivers Month.

Caregiving often means juggling schedules, keeping track of information, and finding support while balancing work and family life. During National Family Caregivers Month, we’re helping caregivers gain AI skills that can make some of those everyday tasks easier, giving them more time to focus on the people they care for.

Participants will also learn how to use AI responsibly, including protecting personal information and understanding the limits of these tools. Participants will also learn when to consult healthcare professionals and how AI tools should complement, not replace, medical, legal, or financial advice. OpenAI facilitators and mentors will offer hands-on support throughout the workshops. No coding or technical background is required.

highlights.title: Here’s How Your Xbox One Can Play GTA 6
highlights.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is out next week, and the game is launching on both Xbox Series X|S and PS5. If you don't have an expensive current-generation system, it previously appeared you would be out of luck to play GTA 6, but that's not the case.
body: Rockstar officially confirmed on November 10 that Grand Theft Auto 6 will support Xbox Cloud Gaming. This feature allows you to stream the game to Xbox Series X|S or Xbox One, and uses Xbox Series S graphics settings. This means it'll look a little worse than running it natively on the Xbox Series X, but if you are still rocking with an Xbox One, this is the only way you can play the game.
"And as with all cloud streaming, connection speeds and other technical factors may influence game performance in ways that would not impact local gameplay," Rockstar added in its announcement.

The catch to all this is that Microsoft just so happened to add a time limit to Xbox Cloud Gaming starting in November. If you have a Game Pass Ultimate subscription, you can play 15 hours a month via Xbox Cloud Gaming. Those without a subscription can buy time, as well, but 50 hours will cost $12, and that's on top of the cost of Grand Theft Auto 6 itself.

highlights.title: The 2026 Best New Bakeries in America
highlights.summary: If there’s one thing we’ve noticed over the past several years, it’s how much bakeries have stepped up their game. We wanted to recognize these achievements by adding this category to the 2026 Eater Awards, celebrating five examples of excellence in pastry, bread, and sweets across the country.
body: Learn more about this year’s Eater Awards, presented by Capital One, and how editors selected them, here.

If one new place in Chicago needs no further hype, it is Bad Butter. You’ll know you’re there when you spot the line cascading out of the whitewashed storefront along West Cortland Street, a queue that doesn’t let up until the pastry case is empty. Formerly a head baker at Soho House Chicago, Dan Koester was stuck at home like the rest of us in 2020, handing off excess home-baked sourdough loaves to friends and family and making some available for free pickup. After he was officially laid off that summer, he launched his own online bakery business, earning a massive following along the way.

One residency at the Emily Hotel later, Koester debuted his Bucktown bakery, demonstrating the full range of his skill. Still warm, charred, and dimpled flats of focaccia showered with scallion furikake rest on its shelves. Impossibly crisp and exquisitely laminated twice-baked almond croissants burst with subtle, aromatic almond paste. A spicy harissa monkey bread with a cloudlike texture is cooled by a pool of creamy labneh drizzled with silky olive oil.

points: The Spurs defeated the Suns, 122-96 tonight in Phoenix.
Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 40 points along with 9 blocks and 11 rebounds for the Spurs, while Dylan Harper tallied 17 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game.
Devin Booker recorded 32 points, 4 assists and 3 three pointers.
The Spurs improve their record to 9-2 with the win, while the Suns fall to 3-6 for the season.
